item.title: UMMC Denies Radiation Exposure Caused Staff Cancer ‘Cluster’
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
UMMC denies claims that radiation safety violations caused a cancer "cluster" in its radiology department. Three staff were diagnosed with cancer, four with thyroid diseases. The hospital says staff radiation exposure levels were below prescribed limits. The post UMMC Denies Radiation Exposure Caused Staff Cancer ‘Cluster’ appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Malaysia Makes Deal With China To Stabilise Medical Devices’ Supply
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia's MDA has reached an agreement with China to increase resin and naphtha supplies for the manufacture of medical devices in Malaysia, says MOH in admitting the "direct impact" of the global energy crisis on availability of critical medical devices.
